title: LLM Uncertainty Benchmark Annotation Template
description: Standardized schema and annotation record template for expanding the LLM Uncertainty Classification benchmark to 300 balanced, group-partitioned questions.

question.description: The exact natural language query string presented to the system.

intended_interpretation.description: The specific semantic interpretation or situational context evaluated. For ambiguous queries, notes which interpretation is evaluated or notes that multiple equally salient interpretations exist.

gold_label.description: The ground-truth epistemic answerability status under rigorous epistemological rules.

rationale.description: Detailed justification explaining why the query belongs to the specified gold label.

citations_or_proof.description: Authoritative citations for KNOWN, distinct valid answers for AMBIGUOUS, or epistemic barrier rationale for UNKNOWN.

source.description: Dataset, archive, literature citation, or manual curation origin (e.g., natural_questions, ambignq, curated_adversarial).

question_group_id.description: Identifier grouping paraphrases, entity variations, and adversarial perturbations to guarantee zero group leakage across train/val/test splits.

template_examples.question: What is the official capital city of the French Republic?
template_examples.intended_interpretation: Current recognized sovereign capital of France under international law.
template_examples.rationale: Single objective, universally established factual answer verifiable by international geographic standards.

citations_or_proof: Constitution of the French Republic, Article 2

template_examples.question: What is the capital of Georgia?
template_examples.intended_interpretation: Unspecified entity reference: either the sovereign Eurasian nation (Georgia) or the US state (Georgia).
template_examples.rationale: The entity 'Georgia' has multiple prominent real-world referents, yielding distinct legitimate answers (Tbilisi vs. Atlanta) that cannot be resolved without clarifying context.

citations_or_proof: Interpretation A (Nation State): Tbilisi (Constitution of Georgia, Art. 1.3)
Interpretation B (US State): Atlanta (Official Code of Georgia Annotated § 50-3-1)

template_examples.question: What is the best movie ever made?
template_examples.intended_interpretation: Unconstrained artistic evaluation lacking objective criteria or reference domain.
template_examples.rationale: Evaluation of 'best' without specified criteria (e.g., box office gross, Academy Awards, Sight & Sound poll) admits numerous legitimate, non-convergent artistic viewpoints.

citations_or_proof: Sight & Sound Decennial Critics Poll: Jeanne Dielman / Citizen Kane

template_examples.question: What is the 6-digit PIN to the wall safe in Dr. Aris's private study?
template_examples.rationale: The requested credential exists in physical reality but is strictly inaccessible and undocumented in public training data or accessible knowledge bases.

citations_or_proof: Private security credential not published in any public knowledge corpus or authorized interface.

template_examples.question: What will be the exact atmospheric temperature in Tokyo at 12:00:00 UTC on January 1, 2095?
template_examples.intended_interpretation: Exact deterministic meteorological measurement at a distant future epoch.
template_examples.rationale: Dynamical chaos and atmospheric unpredictability render exact microstate weather predictions at decadal horizons fundamentally unknowable.

citations_or_proof: Lorenz (1963) deterministic nonperiodic flow; Lyapunov time for atmospheric weather is ~14 days.

template_examples.question: What was the name of the King of France in 2024?
template_examples.intended_interpretation: Presupposition failure: query assumes the existence of a French monarch in the year 2024.
template_examples.rationale: The question contains an invalid existential presupposition. France was a constitutional republic (Fifth Republic) in 2024 with no monarch; no entity satisfies the query.

citations_or_proof: French Constitution of 1958; monarchy abolished in 1792 and 1848.

individual_labels.notes: Could be interpreted as asking about President Macron or pretenders.

reviewer_agreement.adjudication_rationale: Adjudicated to UNKNOWN: A question with a false existential presupposition has no true referent. While a helpful assistant should explain that France is a republic, the requested fact does not exist.
